claim_legs.durability: Git-bound dependencies, prospective pins, immutable first case files, native liveness and exact separate recovery receipts, original snapshots, TAP and absent-root ledgers survive in tracked copies. Saved-only audit/recovery, the book and Knowledge Map preserve current truth.
claim_legs.falsify: Every deliberate omission is rejected by the unchanged original closure oracle. Invented retirement, lost runtime and altered workspace reject, as do native witness substitution, failed/duplicate recovery and closure rewrites with coherent digests. Healthy implementation closure passes.
claim_legs.rederive: Independent current source ownership and healthy-close order predict the selected binding and full trace. The original active-state oracle checks runtime/workspace snapshots, while original receipt/effect and closure oracles run unchanged on actual rows.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before this slice is committed.
limits: Last-observation omissions and complete omission/final release joins remain open; native/startup/parent/full CI/push are separate gates.
scope: Active-runtime healthy control and selected representative source, directory and lock omissions. Qualified current-input binding and omission observers remain unchanged. No retirement is performed; the original runtime reference and private workspace remain intact. Original verdict, actual open alias and later recovery remain separate. No prior fixture replay, original producer/main, compiler, native fixture process or collector; final release and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain gated.
